first.title: Where's your train taking you?
first.hint: Earn ₹50 credit every time you help someone swap
first.signedOutNote: PNR entry works signed out. Sign-in is asked only when you first send or accept a request.
first.coreValue: Tell us what berth you want. We find people on your train who want to swap. You pay ₹99 only when someone says yes.

note.title: Before you start
note.body: SeatSwap is a convenience app. A swap happens only if both of you agree. Keep your original ticket and ID with you.
note.c2: Swaps happen only if both of you agree
note.c3: Keep your original ticket and ID with you

alerts.title: Know when someone says yes
alerts.body: We’ll only tell you about your swaps.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.sub: Your trust keeps this journey going.
privacy.i2t: Berth numbers hidden until you agree
privacy.i2s: You’re in control of what you share.
privacy.i3s: You can remove your data whenever you want.
privacy.body: We show others only your first name and initial, class, coach and berth type. Exact berth numbers are revealed to both sides only after payment. We never show your PNR, full name, phone, email or ticket photo.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.body: Sign-in is needed only to send or accept a request. SeatSwap uses Google sign-in only.
signin.safe: Your PNR and name stay private.
signin.note: Adding a PNR works without sign-in.

home.empty: No trips yet. Add your PNR to see your berth.

add.title: Add your PNR
add.sub: Find your berth and see swap options on your train.
add.pasteBody: Paste the IRCTC booking SMS. We read train, date, class, coach and berth on this device.

trip.peopleWant: {n} people on your train want to swap
trip.openOn: You’re open to swap. Nothing is shared except first name and initial, class, coach and berth type.
trip.openOff: You’re not listed as open to swap.
trip.noReward: Being open to swap earns nothing by itself. You earn ₹50 credit only when a swap is confirmed as done.
trip.wl: Swaps open once your berth is confirmed
trip.wlBody: Your ticket is {status}. We’ll keep this trip and tell you when your berth is confirmed.
trip.canBody: A cancelled ticket cannot be swapped. You can remove this trip.
trip.cancelledInfo: Your open requests are closed. Any money paid is added to your credit.
trip.quota: This berth was given for a reason; it’s only offered to people who qualify.
trip.child: Child without berth: counted in your group, never offered for swap.
trip.chaircar: Seat words for this coach: Window / Aisle / Middle.

swaps.title: Swaps
swaps.empty: No swap requests yet. Add a trip, then ask for a swap. Sending is free — you pay ₹99 only after someone accepts.
swaps.updates: Updates about your swaps will appear here.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Traveller
profile.creditBody: Credit only lowers future SeatSwap fees. Never cash. Valid 12 months after it is earned.
profile.helpAllowed: SeatSwap only helps passengers find each other. Any swap is your own agreement. Keep your original ticket and ID, and follow instructions from railway staff on board.
profile.signInLater: You’ll be asked to sign in with Google only when you send or accept a request.

del.title: Delete my data?
del.body: This removes your trips from this device.

train.title: Train {n}
train.body: Berth layout for train {n}. Add your PNR to see swap options on your date.

footer.line1: Keep your original ticket and ID with you.
footer.line2: SeatSwap is not an official railway service.

offline.bar: No internet — your trips and Swap summary stay available. Adding a PNR needs a connection.
